items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: But then what happened, a colored lawyer, his name is Butts, he sent for us to come up to his office.

ctx.x: Did you have your instruments with you?

No! The sheriff had the instruments. But then what happened, a colored lawyer, his name is Butts, he sent for us to come up to his office. So we went up to his office there. He had the instruments up there. He said, "I got your instruments." Said, "you all can't git 'em, so all you can do is stay here and play." We said, "We can't make no money out there at that place.
